hero.title: From an idea to a professional plan, step by step.
hero.text: Yakın Çevrem is a plan and schedule app for everyone; a guided project start, nine planning tools and export for AI are now part of it. Next up: an income plan, web and desktop apps, and a project space you share with your client.
hero.note: Planned, subject to change. We don't give dates; each stage builds on the one before.

choice.title: You make the call
choice.text: The app doesn't pick a method or a tool for you. It explains what each option is for, when it's unnecessary and what happens if you skip it; you decide.

simple.title: Personal use stays simple
simple.text: Schedule, plans, chat and the couple space stay as they are. The professional tools only show up when you turn them on.

yours.title: Your plan is yours
yours.text: Download your plan as a single Markdown file; give it to whatever you like, including any AI tool.

stages.title: What's coming, stage by stage
stages.text: Each stage gives someone something useful; the next one starts only when it's done.

plan.label: Next
plan.title: From idea to plan
plan.text: Most of the question-by-question tools are already in the app; next come the money-related ones and a few everyday improvements.
items: Income, expense and cash-flow plan; rate calculator for freelancers
"How do I get my app built?" guide: from writing down what you need to choosing a developer and signing off the work
Tools, decisions and comments added to the exported document
Upcoming view in the Agenda, recurring meetups

everywhere.label: Then
everywhere.title: On every screen
everywhere.text: Same account, same plan; on your phone, in the browser and on your computer.
items: Web version: wide screen, keyboard shortcuts, list view
Two-step verification and a list of signed-in sessions

clients.label: After that
clients.title: With your clients and your team
clients.text: For people who work for clients and for small teams.
items: Workspaces with their own layout for freelancers, small teams, companies or communities
Invite people to a project by email; they don't have to be your connections
Client space: share your work with your client the way you'd share a document
"Note to team" and "Reply to client" kept apart; "See as client" before you share
Client requests, the impact of a change and its approval, delivery sign-off
Time tracking, client-approved time summaries, payment milestones

depth.label: Further ahead
depth.title: Going deeper as a team
depth.text: Tools a team needs as it grows.
items: Separate write-ups for the client, the business and engineering; when one changes, the others ask "Is this still right?"
File attachments, labels and @mentions on items

builder.title: I can build software, but not the business side
builder.text: Pricing, competitors, goals and a revenue plan; each with example-led questions.

business.title: I have a business, but not the software side
business.text: Write down what you need, define the first version, choose a developer and accept the work.

freelance.title: I work for clients
freelance.text: You choose what your client sees; requests, approvals and hours in one place.

team.title: I have a team, a club or an association
team.text: Roles, a shared schedule and decisions; in your own way of working.

foundation.title: The foundation is already here
foundation.text: Board, Gantt timeline, critical path, approvals, page plans and templates; plus a guided start, nine planning tools, task numbers, a trash bin and export for AI are in the app today. The roadmap builds on top of them.

pilot.title: Want to try it early?
pilot.text: We'd like to try the new tools with a small group first: people who want to plan their own idea, freelancers working with clients, small teams and associations. Write to us and we'll let you know when it's your turn.
pilot.action: I want to try it early

banner.title: Projects are growing.
banner.text: Guided planning tools and export for AI have arrived. Next up: an income plan, web and desktop apps, and a project space you share with your client.
